tasks.gr9-listening-speaking-t4: Topic: Revision of speeches, listening practice, oral feedback, and fluency consolidation. Cover retrieval of speaking techniques, active listening strategies, constructive feedback reception, and fluency markers. Ask Grade 9 learners to recall presentation strategies, demonstrate active listening, interpret feedback constructively, assess and improve fluency, and prepare for final speaking assessment.
tasks.gr9-reading-viewing-t4: Topic: Revision across literature, visual texts, comprehension strategies, and summary skills. Cover literary recall, visual analysis review, comprehension technique consolidation, and summary best practices. Ask Grade 9 learners to retrieve literary knowledge, analyze visual texts for meaning, apply comprehension strategies to new passages, write concise and accurate summaries, and interpret exam-style questions.
tasks.gr9-writing-presenting-t4: Topic: Report writing, review composition, summary extraction, exam essay practice, and proofreading. Cover report structure review, review balance, summary accuracy, timed essay composition, and error detection. Ask Grade 9 learners to compose reports under pressure, write balanced reviews, summarize efficiently, write exam essays within time limits, and proofread for accuracy.
tasks.gr9-language-structures-t4: Topic: Revision of all major grammar, punctuation mastery, and sentence control. Cover tense consistency, common error patterns, punctuation rules, subject-verb agreement, and sentence construction. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify and correct tense errors, fix sentence fragments and run-ons, apply punctuation rules, ensure agreement, and maintain sentence control in all writing contexts.
